text: Hello! Have you tried the tavern's pie?

offer.text: I'm making a pie, but I'm missing 3 apples. Can you fetch some?

effects.text: Favor accepted! (Hand it in by talking to the person again.)

waiting.text: The apples... the apple trees are outside the walls!

deliver.text: You brought it! Thank you very much, adventurer.

thanks.text: What a pie this will be! Want a slice? No? Then take this.

text: Axel is peaceful... except when a certain goddess shows up.
The monsters outside keep showing up. Good thing we have the Guild.
They say the Guild has a new quest on the board all the time.
I heard about other towns beyond the hills. One day I'll go there!
